370: static block constant_fold(block a, block b, int op) {
371:   if (!block_is_single(a) || !block_is_const(a) ||
372:       !block_is_single(b) || !block_is_const(b))
373:     return gen_noop();
374:   if (op == '+') {
375:     if (block_const_kind(a) == JV_KIND_NULL) {
376:       block_free(a);
377:       return b;
378:     }
379:     if (block_const_kind(b) == JV_KIND_NULL) {
380:       block_free(b);
381:       return a;
382:     }
383:   }
384:   if (block_const_kind(a) != block_const_kind(b))
385:     return gen_noop();
386: 
387:   jv res = jv_invalid();
388: 
389:   if (block_const_kind(a) == JV_KIND_NUMBER) {
390:     jv jv_a = block_const(a);
391:     jv jv_b = block_const(b);
392: 
393:     double na = jv_number_value(jv_a);
394:     double nb = jv_number_value(jv_b);
395: 
396:     int cmp = jv_cmp(jv_a, jv_b);

398:     switch (op) {

400:     case '-': res = jv_number(na - nb); break;
401:     case '*': res = jv_number(na * nb); break;
402:     case '/': res = jv_number(na / nb); break;
403:     case EQ:  res = (cmp == 0 ? jv_true() : jv_false()); break;
404:     case NEQ: res = (cmp != 0 ? jv_true() : jv_false()); break;
405:     case '<': res = (cmp < 0 ? jv_true() : jv_false()); break;
406:     case '>': res = (cmp > 0 ? jv_true() : jv_false()); break;
407:     case LESSEQ: res = (cmp <= 0 ? jv_true() : jv_false()); break;
408:     case GREATEREQ: res = (cmp >= 0 ? jv_true() : jv_false()); break;
409:     default: break;
410:     }
